data.name: EVN Vibe
data.detailed_description:
YEREVAN VIBE

Yerevan is more than a city on the map – it is the place your family once called home. After years away, you return as a talented driver with a single goal: to rediscover your roots and build a better future on the streets that shaped your ancestors.

From busy avenues to quiet backstreets, you will explore a contemporary vision of Yerevan behind the wheel of your car. Every ride is a chance to meet new people, uncover hidden corners of the city, and choose how your reputation will grow. Will you become the reliable professional everyone can trust, the daring driver who takes any risk, or someone in between?

As your circle of contacts expands, so do your opportunities. New jobs, favors, and small adventures appear from the people you help – friends, family, and complete strangers. Some offer money, some offer respect, and some open unexpected doors into the city’s culture and history. Your choices decide who stands with you, which paths remain open, and what kind of life you are building in Yerevan.

More than a driving game, this is a personal journey about connection, identity, and the feeling of coming home to a place you have only known through stories.

Planned key elements

  • Explore a modern, stylized version of Yerevan inspired by real districts and landmarks.

  • Drive as a skilled, responsible driver focused on precision, timing, and situational awareness.

  • Take on varied rides and tasks that introduce new characters, friendships, and rivalries.

  • Shape your future through choices that influence your opportunities and relationships.

  • Discover fragments of family history and local culture as you progress through the city.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Core i5-12400 / Ryzen 5 5600/5600X
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce RTX 2080 Super / Radeon RX 6700 XT
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 9 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: core i7 12700 / AMD Ryzen 7 series
  • Memory: 32 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce RTX 4080 / AMD Radeon RX 7900 XTX
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 9 GB available space
